pl122458792.source: Pleiades (pleiades.stoa.org), Institute for the Study of the Ancient World, CC-BY 3.0
pl122458792.description: Konār Sandal is a Bronze Age archaeological site associated with the "Jiroft culture" (third millennium BCE). The site is located in the valley of the Halil River just south of Jiroft, Kermān Province, Iran. There are, in fact, two tells situated a few kilometers apart. By convention, these mounds are referred to as Konar Sandal A and B.

pl291184549.source: Pleiades (pleiades.stoa.org), Institute for the Study of the Ancient World, CC-BY 3.0
pl291184549.description: Archaeological site in northern Bahrain associated with the Dilmun culture. Three successive temples were built on the site during the 3rd-2nd millennia BCE.
